text_block_list.text:
At last, it's time for Taiki Shuttle's 
Debut Race.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoo!! Finally! It's my debut race!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I came from America and have been waiting 
for this day for a lo~ng time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Besides—I have found a new dream, too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for "Umamusume of the Year," I'm 
gonna achieve so much from here on out, 
yes!
choice_data_list: Go run with everything you've got!
Go out there and run your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeeess! I will run at full power and 
become the winner!"
